    SHP Chaos and Fractals Spring 2021

    Last Updated: April 24, 2021

    Basic info

    This page mostly collects SageMath notebooks for the Spring 2021 SHP course Chaos and Fractals. There is also a github page where there are (temporary) links to the CoCalc pages for the demos and problem notebooks for a given week. The main github page lists these links, and below there are links to the github files for each week.

    Generally, until a few days after a lecture the problems sheet will not have solutions, but after the lecture solutions will be posted in the problems file.
